_note: Proposed test areas. Coordinates are approximate and must be confirmed by a human on a satellite map; set confirmed to true per entry when done. Malapert lat/lon are located from LOLA by the pipeline (the PoC found 85.988S, 2.058E).

lunar.name: Shackleton rim
lunar.why: Crater centre 89.67S 129.78E, diameter ~21 km, so the rim crest passes within ~0.5 km of the pole

lunar.name: Malapert massif
lunar.why: Summit of the massif: the highest LOLA point between 85.6S and 86.4S within 30 km of longitude 0

earth.name: Etna, Italy
earth.why: Upper south flank near Cratere del Laghetto, ~2600 m, the area used for DLR rover tests

earth.name: Bromo / Tengger, Indonesia
earth.why: Tengger sand sea north of the Bromo cone

earth.name: Rinjani, Indonesia
earth.why: Upper north-east flank, away from the Segara Anak lake

earth.name: Askja, Iceland
earth.why: Lava and pumice field north of the caldera, away from Lake Oskjuvatn; Apollo training area

earth.name: Haughton crater, Devon Island
earth.why: Impact structure interior, Haughton-Mars Project area

earth.name: Atacama Yungay, Chile
earth.why: Hyper-arid core used for rover and life-detection tests

earth.name: Mauna Kea, Hawaii
earth.why: Upper south flank cinder terrain used for NASA ISRU field tests

earth.name: Craters of the Moon, Idaho
earth.why: Lava field along the Great Rift

earth.name: Lanzarote, Spain
earth.why: Timanfaya lava fields, ESA Pangaea training area

earth.name: Svalbard, Norway
earth.why: Bockfjorden volcanic complex, AMASE expedition area

mars.name: Jezero crater floor
mars.why: Perseverance landing and driving area; DTM made for its landing navigation
